 Dense fog could be a problem for the Friday morning commute
 By
 Dave Aguilera 
 Dave Aguilera 
 First Alert Chief Meteorologist 
 Watch First Alert Chief Meteorologist Dave Aguilera's weather forecasts on CBS News Colorado -- on TV and on our free streaming service. Check out his bio and send him an email .
 Read Full Bio 
 Dave Aguilera 
 Updated on: October 30, 2026 / 10:09 AM MDT 
 / CBS Colorado
 Add CBS News on Google 
 Friday is a First Alert Weather Day for the dense morning fog forming in the Denver Metro area and across a large chunk of the eastern plains.
 The combination of cool temperatures, light winds and nearly saturated air will be prime ingredients for fog to form. There is a Dense Fog Advisory in place through 10 am for visibility levels down to 1/4 mile or less through 10am.
 Fog should start to thin out after 10am making way for partly cloudy skies and high temperatures in the 60s.
